subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic read-only `routing.list` Gateway RPC and Agents > Channels binding card for per-agent channel bindings, or keep binding visibility in existing Config/CLI surfaces?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful and aligned with channel/UI ergonomics, but it adds core Gateway protocol and Control UI surface rather than fixing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Accept generic routing visibility
options.body: Review and update the linked implementation, or a replacement, to add a current-main read-only routing summary plus focused UI and RPC tests.

options.title: Keep visibility in Config/CLI
options.body: Close this direction after deciding the existing config bindings surface is the supported way to inspect bindings.

options.title: Defer API shape
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product/API design item until maintainers settle the routing summary contract.

recommendation.title: Accept generic routing visibility
recommendation.body: Review and update the linked implementation, or a replacement, to add a current-main read-only routing summary plus focused UI and RPC tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice primarily affects the Agents Control UI shape and related product triage, where the history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
